sentence: He succeeded ___ dint of hard work and perseverance.
explanation: <By dint of> significa como resultado de; debido a.

sentence: ___ to the fact that she was ill, she couldn't attend the meeting.
explanation: <Owing to> significa debido a.

sentence: The decision was made ___ accordance with company policy.
explanation: <In accordance with> significa de una manera que concuerda con o sigue algo.

sentence: ___ of his experience, he was chosen to lead the team.
explanation: <In view of> significa considerando algo.

sentence: He continued to work, ___ of the difficulties he faced.
explanation: <Irrespective of> significa sin tener en cuenta; independientemente de.

sentence: ___ to popular belief, cats are not always aloof.
explanation: <Contrary to> significa en oposición a.

sentence: The project was completed ___ schedule.
explanation: <Ahead of schedule> significa antes de lo planeado.

sentence: She was appointed director ___ virtue of her extensive experience.
explanation: <By virtue of> significa debido a o por medio de.

sentence: ___ to the new regulations, all employees must undergo training.
explanation: <Pursuant to> significa de conformidad con (una ley o una solicitud).

sentence: He managed to finish the task ___ of his limited resources.
explanation: <In spite of> significa a pesar de.

sentence: ___ to the fact that he was busy, he still helped me.
explanation: <Despite the fact that> significa aunque.

sentence: She spoke ___ if she knew everything about the subject.
explanation: <As if> significa como si.

sentence: ___ as it may seem, he was telling the truth.
explanation: <Strange as it may seem> es una expresión idiomática que significa que puede parecer extraño, pero es verdad.

sentence: ___ it is raining, we will still go for a walk.
explanation: <Even though> significa a pesar de que.

sentence: He studied hard, ___ he might pass the exam.
explanation: <So that> significa para que.

sentence: ___ he is rich, he is not happy.
explanation: <Although> significa a pesar de que.

sentence: He continued to work, ___ of his illness.
explanation: <Regardless of> significa sin tener en cuenta.

sentence: The meeting was postponed ___ account of the bad weather.
explanation: <On account of> significa debido a.

sentence: ___ to the latest reports, the economy is improving.
explanation: <According to> significa según lo declarado por.

sentence: The meeting was cancelled ___ to unforeseen circumstances.
explanation: <Due to> significa debido a.
